gloss: to produce, to create, to generate

definitions.gloss: to produce, to create, to generate
definitions.explanation: To bring something new into existence through effort or creativity. Used for ideas, works, products, profits, or results.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいアイデアを{生|う}み{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To come up with a new idea.

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}は{毎日|まいにち}{多|おお}くの{製品|せいひん}を{生|う}み{出|だ}している。
examples.english: This factory produces many products every day.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}が{素晴|すば}らしい{結果|けっか}を{生|う}み{出|だ}した。

notes:
{生|う}み{出|だ}す combines {生|う}む (to give birth, to produce) and {出|だ}す (to put out).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Takes を particle: 〜を{生|う}み{出|だ}す

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アイデアを{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to generate ideas
- {利益|りえき}を{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to generate profit
- {価値|かち}を{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to create value
- {作品|さくひん}を{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to produce works

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生|う}み{出|だ}す: to create, produce (emphasizes bringing something new into being)
- {作|つく}る: to make (general, broader use)
- {創造|そうぞう}する: to create (formal, emphasizes originality)
